title: Combining ideas into complex sentences (Writing Task 2)

drills.instruction: Combine the two sentences with the word in brackets.

items.cue: Public transport is cheap. Many people still drive. (although)
answers: Although public transport is cheap, many people still drive.
Many people still drive although public transport is cheap.

items.cue: Cities are growing. Housing is becoming expensive. (as)
answers: As cities are growing, housing is becoming expensive.
Housing is becoming expensive as cities are growing.

items.cue: Remote work saves time. It can make people feel isolated. (while)
answers: While remote work saves time, it can make people feel isolated.
